# Data Model

<!-- Generated by /ai-context. Manual edits are overwritten on re-run. -->

## AS IS — Current state

### Entities

Room database `AppDatabase` (`app/src/main/java/com/mytracksapp/data/local/AppDatabase.kt`), schema version 2, entities `TrackingSessionEntity` + `GpsPointEntity`.

**`TrackingSessionEntity`** — table `tracking_sessions` (`data/local/entity/TrackingSessionEntity.kt`)

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `String` (PK) | UUID string — fixed type because the CSV export schema requires `session_id` as a UUID string |
| `samplingIntervalSeconds` | `Int` | one of `SamplingInterval.ALLOWED_SECONDS` |
| `startTimestamp` | `Long` | epoch millis |
| `endTimestamp` | `Long?` | `null` while `ACTIVE`; set on `stopSession` |
| `status` | `SessionStatus` (`ACTIVE`/`FINISHED`) | persisted as TEXT via Room's enum converter |
| `stoppedTimeMillis` | `Long` (default `0`) | set once, on session end, from `SegmentClassifier` |
| `movingTimeMillis` | `Long` (default `0`) | set once, on session end |
| `averageSpeedMetersPerSecond` | `Double` (default `0.0`) | set once, on session end, from `StatsEngine` |
| `locationName` | `String?` | `null` until (and unless) reverse geocoding succeeds |
| `distanceMeters` | `Double` (default `0.0`) | set once, on session end |

Invariant: per-point classification (segment status, instant speed) is deliberately **not**
duplicated onto any entity — always recomputed on demand from raw `GpsPointEntity` rows by
`StatsEngine`/`SegmentClassifier`, so a stored value can never drift from a recomputation.

**`GpsPointEntity`** — table `gps_points` (`data/local/entity/GpsPointEntity.kt`)

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `Long` (PK, autoGenerate) | |
| `sessionId` | `String` | FK → `tracking_sessions.id`, `onDelete = CASCADE`, indexed (`@Index("sessionId")`) |
| `timestamp` | `Long` | real observed time, not the configured interval |
| `latitude` | `Double` | |
| `longitude` | `Double` | |
| `accuracy` | `Float` | as reported by the location provider |
| `observedIntervalDriftMillis` | `Long?` | `(observed gap) - configuredIntervalMillis`; `null` for a session's first point |

Relationship: one `TrackingSessionEntity` → many `GpsPointEntity`, cascade-deleted together
(`TrackingSessionDao.deleteById`/`deleteAll` comments confirm the FK cascade removes points too).

### Storage

- Engine: SQLite via Room 2.6.1 (`data/local/AppDatabase.kt`), database file name `my-tracks-app.db`.
- Schema location: entity annotations in `data/local/entity/`; `exportSchema = false` — no JSON schema files are generated/checked in.
- Migration tool: none — `Room.databaseBuilder(...).fallbackToDestructiveMigration()` (`AppDatabase.kt`); no `Migration` classes exist, so a version bump destroys and recreates the local database rather than migrating data.
- DAOs: `TrackingSessionDao` (insert/update/getSessionById/getAllSessions/getSessionsByStatus/deleteById/deleteAll/updateLocationName) and `GpsPointDao` (insert/insertAll/getPointsForSession ordered `ASC` by `timestamp`/countForSession) — both in `data/local/dao/`.
- Singleton access: `AppDatabase.getInstance(context)` — double-checked-locking singleton per process (`AppDatabase.kt` companion object).

### Cache

- `SettingsRepository` (`data/settings/SettingsRepository.kt`) memoizes one `DataStore<Preferences>` instance per `dataStoreName` in a `mutableMapOf` guarded by a lock (`instancesLock`/`instances`), preventing two competing `DataStore` instances from opening the same underlying file — this is the only in-memory cache in the codebase; there is no separate read-through/LRU cache layer.
- `AppDatabase.getInstance` similarly caches a single `Room` instance per process via `@Volatile instance`.
